newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Nov retail climate better, but still gloomy.
newsitem.headline: German Nov retail climate better, but still gloomy.

text.p: Business confidence among German retailers rose in November but the outlook remains on balance negative, a survey of retailers by BBE management consultancy published in Monday's Handelsblatt showed.

The BBE's index, based on a survey of 200 retailers, rose in November to 95.7 from 91.2 in the previous month -- but still stood below 100 the level which would show that optimists and pessimists were equal in number.

Shop hours were extended in November, but retailers say the crucial pre-Christmas shopping season has not being going well with turnover down on Saturdays and only partly offset by extra takings from late weekday shopping.
Only 10 percent of the store owners said that they expected to hire more workers to cope with the longer store hours.
